title: btrv.heatmap 1.0 - metadata block of a heat-map file
description: Stored as HDF5 root attributes (.h5) or as the JSON string in the 'meta' member of an .npz file. Grids live in the 'grid' dataset [N, grid_height, grid_width]; 'frame_index' [N] and 'timestamp_s' [N] align each grid with a source frame. Row 0 is the y_min edge, column 0 the x_min edge of the extent.

space.description: Coordinate space of the extent: full source-frame pixels or sportvu_feet_v1 court feet.

extent.description: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max] covered by the grid, in the declared space. Independent of the video resolution.

normalization.description: sum_to_one: each grid sums to 1; max_one: each grid's maximum is 1; unit_range: values in [0,1] with no per-frame constraint.
